<!-- All news items below this line -->
*
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2017 Westminster attack]]
**Authorities arrest at least eight people in connection with yesterday's attack. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/03/23/london-attack-british-police-reportedly-make-arrests-in-raid-on-home.html (Fox News)] 
**London's [[Metropolitan Police Service]] announces that the attacker is [[United Kingdom|British]]-born Khalid Masood, previously questioned by British authorities for connections to terrorism. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-security-attacker-idUSKBN16U26E (Reuters)] 
**The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]] claims responsibility. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/03/23/london-attack-seven-arrested-police-raid-properties-linked-islamist/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*A former Ukrainian soldier assassinates former [[Russian Duma]] deputy [[Denis Voronenkov]] in the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] capital [[Kiev]]. In December 2016, he received Ukrainian citizenship. [[Ilya Ponomarev]] says Voronenkov was heading to a meeting with him. [https://themoscowtimes.com/news/breaking-former-russian-parliamentarian-and-putin-critic-shot-dead-in-kiev-57513 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**[[Taliban]] insurgents seize control of the strategic town of [[Sangin]] in the southern [[Helmand Province]] after a year-long battle with [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] security forces. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-39365330 (BBC)]
*[[Vehicle-ramming attack|2017 Antwerp attack]]
**A man drives into a crowd of pedestrians in [[Antwerp]], [[Belgium]], injuring several people. Police arrest the man, who is believed to be North African born and living in [[France]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/03/23/world/europe/antwerp-belgium-car-attack.html?_r=0 (''The New York Times'')]

;Arts and culture
*The [[United States|American]] city of [[Fort Collins, Colorado]], announces its intention to appeal a federal judge's ruling that blocked the city’s ban on women appearing topless in public. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170325202317/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/city-vows-to-appeal-ruling-that-allows-women-to-go-topless/ar-BByBZSi?li=BBnbfcL&ocid=iehp (''USA Today'' via MSN)]
*Cardinal [[William H. Keeler|William Henry Keeler]], who was [[Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Baltimore|Archbishop of Baltimore]] from 1989 to 2007, dies at the age of 86. At the [[United States Conference of Catholic Bishops]] (USCCB), he served as the moderator for [[Catholic Church and Judaism|Catholic-Jewish relations]] as well as the Chair for the Bishops’ Committee for [[Committee on Ecumenical and Interreligious Affairs|Ecumenical and Interreligious Affairs]] between 1984 and 1987. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/baltimore-mourns-cardinal-keeler-former-archbishop-81157 (Catholic News Agency)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A series of explosions on a military base near the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] city of [[Balakliya]] forces thousands to be evacuated from their homes. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-39363416 (BBC)]
*[[Sinking of MV Sewol]]
**The [[South Korea]]n government raises the wreckage of the [[MV Sewol|MV ''Sewol'']] from the sea near the South Korean island of [[Donggeochado]]. The ferry sank in April 2014, killing 304 people. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-39361944 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[American Health Care Act of 2017]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]] approaches a vote on a replacement plan for the [[Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act]] (aka Obamacare). [http://www.cnn.com/2017/03/22/politics/house-health-care-bill/ (CNN)]
**The U.S. House postpones the vote due to a lack of support and slow progress in dealmaking. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/03/23/politics/house-health-care-vote/ (CNN)]

;Science and environment
*The [[night parrot]] is confirmed sighted (and photographed) in [[Western Australia]] for first time in nearly 100 years. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2017/mar/23/night-parrot-sighting-confirmed-in-western-australia-for-first-time-in-100-years (''The Guardian'')]
